remarks: This charming second floor, two-bedroom, one-bath apartment in the heart of Greenwich offers unbeatable convenience. Nestled close to the train station, Bruce Park, and Greenwich Avenue, you'll enjoy effortless access to the area's best shopping, dining, and entertainment. Inside, enjoy a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, a formal dining room, and a well-equipped kitchen. This unique layout offers incredible versatility with both a den and a dedicated office, providing the perfect setup for remote work, a hobby room, or a guest room. Relax on the private back deck, perfect for morning coffee or small gatherings. Plus, the convenience of in-unit laundry makes everyday living easier. This is the perfect place to enjoy all that Greenwich has to offer.
